title: Persons-DB migrations: idempotent, SAFE-annotated SQL in rust/persons_migrations
answers: How do I add a table to the persons database?
Where do persons DB migrations live?
What should a persons migration look like?
body:
Persons-DB schema changes are plain timestamped SQL files in `rust/persons_migrations/` (e.g. `20260923000001_add_person_tombstone_publish_queue.sql`), run by `sqlx migrate run` in CI.
- Use `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` / `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` so re-applying is a no-op (the PR verified by applying twice).
- Start the file with a header comment including a `-- SAFE:` line stating why it is safe to deploy (e.g. new empty table, no locks on existing tables).
- Add a `COMMENT ON TABLE` describing the table's meaning; comments are otherwise kept minimal.
- Roles in the `readwrite` tier (personhog-replica, dagster) use `pg_read_all_data`/`pg_write_all_data`, so new tables need no GRANT.
applies: Adding or changing tables in the persons Postgres DB (rust/persons_migrations).
